description: Brand/logo display. Authored content is never modified; the src attribute adds one owned <picture data-brand-mark-img> logo with optional dark-mode and compact variants

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Logo image URL (light mode / default). Inserts an owned <picture data-brand-mark-img>; removing it removes only that element

attributes.name: src-dark
attributes.description: Dark-mode logo URL; follows <html data-mode>, then the resolved color-scheme, then prefers-color-scheme

attributes.name: src-compact
attributes.description: Compact/icon logo URL, used while compact-media matches (a <source> in the owned <picture>)

attributes.name: compact-media
attributes.description: Media query for src-compact (default: (width < 48rem), the --bp-m breakpoint)

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: Logo text alternative. Image-only: becomes the accessible name and authored content is hidden from AT. Otherwise used only when there is no authored text

attributes.name: wordmark
attributes.description: Show authored content alongside the src logo (without it, authored content is visually hidden but stays the accessible name)

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Logo height: a number (px) or a CSS length; sets --brand-mark-height

attributes.name: data-stack
attributes.description: Stack logo, name and tagline vertically

attributes.name: data-brand-mark-img
attributes.description: Marks the <picture> the component owns (inserted from src)
